scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npm run wrangler:config && npm exec -w apps/web -- wrangler deploy --config .local/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:local: npm exec -w apps/web -- wrangler d1 migrations apply fruitery --local
scripts.migrate:remote: npm run wrangler:config && npm exec -w apps/web -- wrangler d1 migrations apply fruitery --remote --config .local/wrangler.toml
scripts.seed:local: npm run gen:seed && npm exec -w apps/web -- wrangler d1 execute fruitery --local --file=.local/seed.sql
scripts.seed:remote: npm run gen:seed && npm run wrangler:config && npm exec -w apps/web -- wrangler d1 execute fruitery --remote --config .local/wrangler.toml --file=.local/seed.sql
